note: The grounded-answer prompt, defined ONCE. The browser builds prompts from this file and so does the fine-tuning data generator. If the two ever drift; the model is trained on one format and served another, which produces worse output with no error anywhere, the same failure mode the search tokenizer has and for the same reason. scripts/check-prompt.ts pins the rendered result against a golden fixture.

budget.note: 1400 chars is roughly 390 BPE tokens, leaving well over half of the 1024-token window for the answer. A character budget rather than a token count because the tokenizer lives in WebAssembly and this has to be computable before the model is loaded.
